title: GIRDER NEW 2025 BISON
notes: Exact NEW 2025 BISON page lists ¥13,800; frame/fork text identical to DASH; 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12, FC-R7100 52-36T 170 mm, cassette written 'CS-7100 11-34T', R7120 hydraulic discs, no chain listed; Adler Augen Pista 50 mm carbon wheels; Maxxis 28C; weight 8.30 kg (basis not stated). Official chart (shared by the DASH and BISON pages), stack/reach mm for listed sizes: 440 500/366, 490 514/375, 520 527/380, 540 545/384; seat angle 75.5–74°, head angle 70.5–73°, chainstay 410 mm, wheelbase 970–980 mm. The chart also lists 560 and 580 rows that the page does not offer and leaves BB drop blank. Not the older ROAD-section BISON (ROAD/30.html, press-fit, Ultegra R8020 2×11, ¥14,800). Read over HTTP, matching the site’s published links.
